title: A constant-factor approximation of the Gromov-Hausdorff distance in the plane
summary: We give the first polynomial-time constant-factor approximation of the Gromov-Hausdorff distance d_GH between finite point sets in the Euclidean plane; in fixed Euclidean dimension such an approximation was previously known only on the line (Majhi, Vitter and Wenk, 2024). Global alignment cannot succeed: the classical dimension drop defeats alignment by isometries, a multiplicity gap defeats alignment by bijections, and a reflection barrier defeats sorting under any single global reflection pattern.
